summary: Post-WebR273 Noether Paper 35 full-650dpi source-audit patch. It starts from the current WebR273 plus LocalCodex Paper 40 survival base, checks Paper 35 against eight staged 650dpi source-page renders for printed pp.65-72, applies five source-visible fixes, and compiles the resulting German cumulative to 471 pages.
global_caveat: This is a targeted Paper 35 source-audit/current-control artifact only. It does not certify the whole Noether cumulative, does not synchronize downstream English/Spanish/Japanese/French/Slavic branches, does not claim whole-corpus closure, and is not critical-edition material. The witness quality is unusually strong for this lane because it uses 650dpi rendered source pages, but the package still remains a local paper-level audit tranche rather than a global edition claim.
